orlando_stadium_256.env is derived from the HDRI "Orlando Stadium" by Poly Haven
(photography Dimitrios Savva, processing Greg Zaal), https://polyhaven.com/a/orlando_stadium,
1k .hdr downloaded on 18 Oct 2026 from
https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/HDRIs/hdr/1k/orlando_stadium_1k.hdr

Converted to a prefiltered Babylon .env (256 px cube, spherical harmonics, PNG faces) with
tests/web/hdr-to-env.mjs (Babylon.js 9.29.0 HDRCubeTexture and EnvironmentTextureTools).
